welcome.title: Welcome to Chainfolio
welcome.subtitle: Your whole on-chain portfolio in one calm, private place. Let's set things up — it takes less than a minute.

chains.title: Every chain
chains.body: Ethereum, L2s, Solana, Bitcoin, TRON and XRP.

pnl.title: Real PnL
pnl.body: FIFO, LIFO or average cost, always up to date.

privacy.title: Private by design
privacy.subtitle: Chainfolio works without an account and never touches your funds.

watchOnly.title: Watch-only
watchOnly.body: You add public addresses. We never ask for private keys or seed phrases and can't move funds.

local.title: Stays on your device
local.body: Wallets, balances and settings live in a local database. No servers, no telemetry.

openSource.title: Open source
openSource.body: MIT licensed. Anyone can read, audit and improve the code.

personalize.title: Make it yours
personalize.subtitle: You can change any of this later in Settings.

modules.title: Optional modules
modules.subtitle: Turn on only what you need.
modules.taxBody: Brazilian income tax (IR) reports: monthly R$ 35k exemption, capital gains and annual holdings. Estimates only.
modules.later: More modules (alerts, DeFi) arrive as the app grows.
modules.previewSubtitle: Sales up to R$ 35k a month are exempt from income tax.

ready.title: You're all set
ready.subtitle: How would you like to start?

wallet.title: Add your first wallet
wallet.body: Paste a public address, ENS name or xpub.

tour.title: Take a quick tour
tour.body: See every part of the app in about a minute.

demo.title: Explore with demo data
demo.body: Try the dashboard with a sample portfolio.

welcome.keyboardHint: Tip: use ← → to move between steps

navigation.title: Navigation
navigation.body: Everything lives here: portfolio, assets, transactions, DeFi, analytics, risk and alerts. Collapse it at the bottom for more room.

search.title: Search and commands
search.body: Press Ctrl K anywhere to jump to a page or run an action like switching theme or hiding balances.

privacy.title: Privacy mode
privacy.body: One click hides every balance. Handy for screen sharing or working in public.

portfolio.title: Your portfolio
portfolio.body: Total value and performance over time. Hover the chart to see the value on any day.

filters.title: Periods and filters
filters.body: Switch the period, pick specific dates, or narrow the chart down to the assets you care about.

risk.title: Risk score
risk.body: A 0–100 score built from concentration, stablecoin depeg exposure and open token approvals.

mood.title: Market mood
mood.body: Today's crypto Fear & Greed index, compared with yesterday, last week and last month.

wallets.title: Your wallets
wallets.body: Add public addresses here. Chainfolio reads balances and history — it never asks for keys.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Language, theme, base currency, optional modules, and this tour whenever you need it again.

updates.title: Updates
updates.availableHint: A new version is ready to install.
updates.autoHint: Look for new releases on startup and every few hours.
updates.desktopOnly: Updates are available in the desktop app.

wallets.addDescription: Paste a public address, an ENS or SNS name, or a Bitcoin extended public key.
wallets.supported: EVM (0x… or .eth), Solana (base58 or .sol), Bitcoin (address or xpub/ypub/zpub), TRON (T…) and XRP Ledger (r… or X…).
wallets.watchOnlyNote: Watch-only: Chainfolio only reads public balances. Never paste a seed phrase or private key.
wallets.syncPartial_one: {{count}} source failed to refresh; showing its last known balances.
wallets.syncPartial_other: {{count}} sources failed to refresh; showing their last known balances.
wallets.removeDescription: Its balances are deleted from this device. You can add the address again at any time.
wallets.desktopOnly: Wallets are stored by the desktop app. Run Chainfolio with `pnpm tauri dev` to add one.

errors.invalidAddress: Not a valid EVM, Solana, Bitcoin, TRON or XRP Ledger address.
errors.badChecksum: Checksum mismatch. Check for typos in the address.
errors.nameNotFound: This name doesn't resolve to an address.
errors.duplicate: This wallet is already being tracked.
errors.network: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
errors.storage: Couldn't save to the local database.
errors.invalidAlert: This alert can never fire. Check its threshold.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Protect the local database with a master password
security.onHint: The database is encrypted with SQLCipher and opens only with your password.
security.offHint: Anyone with access to this computer can open your wallet list and balances.
security.autoLockHint: Lock the app after this much time without activity. Background sync pauses while locked.
security.noRecovery: There is no way to recover a forgotten password. Keep it somewhere safe; without it the data can only be re-added from scratch or from a backup.
security.setDescription: Your database will be encrypted. You'll need this password every time Chainfolio starts.
security.changeDescription: The database is re-encrypted with the new password.
security.removeDescription: The database will be decrypted and stored in plain form on this computer.
security.lockedHint: Enter your master password to decrypt your data.

background.title: Background & tray
background.subtitle: Keep Chainfolio watching while the window is closed
background.intervalHint: Refresh balances and prices on this schedule and check your alerts afterwards.
background.closeToTrayHint: Closing the window keeps Chainfolio running in the system tray. Quit from the tray menu.
background.launchAtLoginHint: Start Chainfolio hidden in the tray when you sign in to your computer.
background.notificationsHint: Show a system notification when one of your alerts fires.

alerts.dialogDescription: Checked after every sync. Prices are in US dollars.

kinds.balanceChange: Funds move in or out of a wallet

kindHints.priceAbove: Fires once when the price crosses the target, then waits until it falls back.
kindHints.priceBelow: Fires once when the price crosses the target, then waits until it recovers.
kindHints.portfolioChange: Compares your portfolio value with 24 hours ago.
kindHints.balanceChange: Compares balances between two syncs, valued at current prices.
kindHints.depeg: Watches every stablecoin you hold (USDT, USDC, DAI…) for drift away from $1.

rule.balanceEither: {{amount}} or more moves in or out of {{wallet}}
rule.depeg: A stablecoin you hold drifts {{percent}} from $1

alerts.waitingReset: waiting for the condition to clear
alerts.historyHint: The last 50 times a rule fired
alerts.schedule: Alerts are checked after every sync, including the background refresh every {{minutes}} min.
alerts.scheduleOff: Background refresh is off, so alerts are only checked when you sync manually.
alerts.emptyHint: Get a notification when a price crosses a target, your portfolio swings, funds move in a wallet or a stablecoin depegs.
